notes.title: New patch released!
notes.notes:
We have released an update to improve underage console profile management.
This will help our systems handle such profiles more effectively. Read more on our website!

notes.title: New patch available!
notes.notes:
Hello Turbochargers!

We have just released a new patch to fix the bug related to the Steam Deck: the cutscenes in Story Mode are now visible. Darla and Robert are waiting for you on track!

notes.title: New patch available!
notes.notes:
Our latest patch is live, featuring new thrills. We have increased the number of variants for all the vehicles and added the Secret vehicles in the shop: if you already own them, they will now have a chance to become purchasable. Get ready for more Hot Wheels Unleashed™ 2 action!

Read the patch notes here!

notes.title: New Patch released!
notes.notes:
Hello, Turbochargers! Our brand new HWU2 update is rolling out: refreshed "Unleashed Missions" descriptions, a fix for a boost bug tied to certain perks, and other Game Modes improvements.

Check all the details on our website!
